src.alt: Hee&Lee web design team at work

about-text-1.paragraph: Your website should be more than just good-looking, it should work hard for your brand. We build responsive, SEO-friendly sites that are designed to convert and easy to manage.

about-text-2.paragraph: Whether you’re launching something new or upgrading your online presence, we blend design and tech to create fast, smart, and user-focused websites that deliver real results.

style.about-section: display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; width:100%; padding:110px 120px; background-color:var(--hl-cream); @media(--tablet){padding:80px 40px;} @media(--mobile){padding:64px 16px;}
style.about-inner: display:flex; flex-direction:row; align-items:center; gap:80px; width:100%; max-width:1200px; padding:0; @media(--tablet){flex-direction:column; align-items:stretch; gap:56px;} @media(--mobile){gap:40px;}
style.about-visual: position:relative; width:560px; max-width:100%; aspect-ratio:560/540; flex-shrink:0; padding:0; @media(--tablet){margin:0 auto;}
style.about-image-main: position:absolute; left:0; top:1.85%; width:73.2%; height:88.9%; object-fit:cover; border:2px solid var(--hl-ink); border-radius:24px; box-shadow:8px 8px 0px 0px #0e2a25; @media(--mobile){border-radius:18px; box-shadow:6px 6px 0px 0px #0e2a25;}
style.about-image-small: position:absolute; left:53.6%; top:55.6%; width:44.6%; height:42.6%; object-fit:cover; border:2px solid var(--hl-ink); border-radius:20px; box-shadow:6px 6px 0px 0px #0e2a25; @media(--mobile){border-radius:14px; box-shadow:4px 4px 0px 0px #0e2a25;}
style.about-content: display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:flex-start; gap:24px; flex:1 1 0; min-width:0; padding:0; @media(--mobile){gap:20px;}
style.about-eyebrow-text: font-family:var(--font-body); font-size:13px; letter-spacing:1.82px; line-height:1.2; color:var(--hl-coral); margin:0;
style.about-title: font-family:var(--font-display); font-weight:400; font-size:56px; line-height:1.02; color:var(--hl-green); margin:0; @media(--tablet){font-size:44px;} @media(--mobile){font-size:34px;}
style.about-features: display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:14px 20px; width:100%; padding:0; @media(--mobile){grid-template-columns:1fr; gap:12px;}
style.about-cta: display:inline-flex; align-items:center; font-family:var(--font-body); font-weight:600; font-size:16px; line-height:1.2; color:var(--hl-ink); background-color:var(--hl-amber); border:1.5px solid var(--hl-ink); border-radius:100px; padding:15px 28px; box-shadow:3px 3px 0px 0px #0e2a25; transition:transform 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; &:hover{transform:translate(2px, 2px); box-shadow:1px 1px 0px 0px #0e2a25; color:var(--hl-ink); background-color:var(--hl-amber);}
style.about-feature-check-1: display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; width:24px; height:24px; flex-shrink:0; border-radius:12px; background-color:var(--hl-green); color:#ffffff; font-family:var(--font-body); font-weight:700; font-size:12px; line-height:1; margin:0;
style.about-feature-text-1: font-family:var(--font-body); font-weight:600; font-size:16px; line-height:1.3; color:var(--hl-ink); margin:0; @media(--mobile){font-size:15px;}
